projects.notes_en: Orange Basin, offshore Namibia, Block 2913B (~3,000m WD). One of the largest deepwater discoveries of the past decade (~6 Bboe potential). July 2026 CEO comments: technically ready for FID, but delayed by unresolved negotiations with the Namibian government on fiscal terms and gas handling — target moved from Q3 to Q4 2026. projects.notes: PEL 83, Orange Basin, offshore Namibia. TotalEnergies가 2025-12 Galp으로부터 운영권 인수, 거래 2026-09-04 최종 완료(나미비아 당국 승인). Partners: TotalEnergies 40% (op), Galp 40%, Namcor 10%, Custos 10%. TotalEnergies는 PEL83 탐사·평가 CAPEX 중 Galp 몫의 50% carry. 자원 추정: 800M–1.1B boe. FPSO 개념 200k+ bpd; FID 목표 2028(재확인). 탐사·평가 캠페인 2026–2027 (Mopane Extension 공 2026년 하반기 시추 개시 + 추가 2공 2027). CAPEX 미공시 (greenfield Namibia 프리미엄, cf. Venus $16B). First oil ~2030–2031. TotalEnergies Namibia 2번째 축(PEL 80 Venus와 병행).
projects.notes_en: PEL 83, Orange Basin, offshore Namibia. TotalEnergies took operatorship from Galp in Dec 2025; deal finally closed 2026-09-04 (Namibian regulatory approval). Partners: TotalEnergies 40% (op), Galp 40%, Namcor 10%, Custos 10%. TotalEnergies carries 50% of Galp's share of PEL 83 exploration & appraisal CAPEX. Resource estimate: 800M–1.1B boe. FPSO concept 200k+ bpd; FID target 2028 (reconfirmed). E&A campaign 2026–2027 (Mopane Extension well spudding H2 2026 + 2 more wells in 2027). CAPEX undisclosed (greenfield Namibia premium; cf. Venus $16B). First oil ~2030–2031. TotalEnergies' second Namibia hub (alongside PEL 56 Venus).

projects.notes: Orange Basin, offshore Namibia, PEL 39 (~2,000–3,000m WD). Shell 45% (op), QatarEnergy 45%, NAMCOR 10%. Jan 2025: Shell $400M write-down 발표 — 일부 유정 "상업성 없음(not commercially viable)" 판단. 2025년 시추 캠페인 일시 중단. 개발 컨셉 및 FID 타임라인 불확실. 잠재 FID 2026, first oil 2030+ (단, 상업성 재검토 완료 후). [2026-10-13 검증] 실제 단계는 평가(appraisal) — 개발 컨셉 미정, 2026년 말 평가정 2공 계획. 스키마에 평가 단계가 없어 Pre-FEED로 표기.
projects.notes_en: Orange Basin, offshore Namibia, PEL 39 (~2,000–3,000m WD). Shell 45% (op), QatarEnergy 45%, NAMCOR 10%. Jan 2025: Shell announced a $400M write-down — some wells judged "not commercially viable". 2025 drilling campaign paused. Development concept and FID timeline uncertain. Potential FID 2026, first oil 2030+ (only after commercial review is complete). [2026-10-13 verification] Actually at appraisal — no development concept; 2 appraisal wells planned end-2026. Shown as Pre-FEED because the schema has no appraisal phase.

At FID: Shell 55% (op), ExxonMobil 20%, ENI (Agip) 12.5%, TotalEnergies 12.5%. TotalEnergies fully exited (Dec 2025, $510M): Shell acquired 10% (ENI exercised pre-emption on 2.5%). Current: Shell 65% (op), ENI 15%, ExxonMobil 20%. Peak ~110k bbl/d.

projects.notes: OML 222, offshore Nigeria (~1,500m WD). **신규 FPSO 없음** — 기존 Usan FPS로의 30km+ 심해 타이백. 20–40 wells. CAPEX $7–8B (ExxonMobil 확인). FID 목표 early 2027; first oil ~2030. Peak ~100k bbl/d. projects.notes_en: OML 222, offshore Nigeria (~1,500m WD). **No new FPSO** — 30km+ deepwater tie-back to the existing Usan FPSO. 20–40 wells. CAPEX $7–8B (confirmed by ExxonMobil). Core of a $10B Nigeria deepwater program (Owowo + Usan infill $1B + Bosi). ~$1B of early-works spend (~30% of total) already committed.

projects.notes: UK North Sea, uHPHT gas condensate. Subsea tie-back to Shearwater hub; ~40k boepd. Shell 100% (op). Topside installed October 2025; first gas targeted Q3–Q4 2026. 2026-03 OPRED 추가 기술정보 요청(규제 리스크 잔존). [2026-10-08] 영국 정부 재승인 지연 — 9월 중순 예상이었으나 늦가을로 연기(2026-09-12 보도). 설비 ~99% 완공, 승인 즉시 생산 가능하나 2026년 내 first gas 불확실. [2026-10-13 검증] FID 2023→2022-07(Shell FID, OGJ 2022-07-25).
projects.notes_en: UK North Sea, uHPHT gas condensate. Subsea tie-back to Shearwater hub; ~40k boepd. Shell 100% (op). Topside installed October 2025; first gas targeted Q3–Q4 2026. March 2026: OPRED requested additional technical information (regulatory risk remains). [2026-10-08] UK government re-approval delayed — expected mid-September, now pushed to late autumn (reported 2026-09-12). Facilities ~99% complete and could produce immediately on approval, but 2026 first gas is uncertain. [2026-10-13 verification] FID 2023→2022-07 (Shell FID, OGJ 2022-07-25).

projects.notes_en: Norwegian Barents Sea, northernmost NCS oil discovery (~300m WD). Equinor 35% (op), TotalEnergies 35%, Petoro 20%, INPEX Idemitsu 10%. CAPEX ~NOK 104B (~$10.2B USD). Arctic-rated power-from-shore concept dropped — now gas-turbine power generation. projects.notes_en: UK North Sea, Block 211/13a (~150m WD, HE). Shell 50% (op), NEO Energy 50%. First oil February 2025. New-build HE FPSO replacing ageing infrastructure. [2026-10-13 검증] FID 2021→2018-01(OE Digital 2018-01-15). CAPEX 2.0은 Shell 미공시 — 추정치(Bernstein 최대 $2.5B). [2026-10-13 verification] FID 2021→2018-01 (OE Digital, 2018-01-15). projects.notes_en: Offshore Abu Dhabi sour gas megaproject. ~1.5 Bcf/d. Partner history: Wintershall Dea→PTTEP (Jun 2024), Eni 25%→10% (ADNOC 55%→70%, Apr 2024), OMV→Lukoil (2023)→ADNOC (Nov 2025, sanctions). projects.notes_en: Pre-salt Santos Basin. New FPSO to expand Tupi (Tupi/Iracema) field production — 100k bbl/d chartered unit, Petrobras 100% (op). FID expected 2030+; first oil tentatively 2033-2034. Use of existing Tupi production infrastructure (6 FPSOs in operation) may reduce some subsea cost. FPSO build cost: undisclosed (to be chartered). May be designated P-90, but not officially confirmed. Note: Tupi passed 4 billion boe cumulative production in 2026 (a first in Petrobras' 73-year history); REVIT is a core Petrobras strategy to raise recovery, but this REVIT Tupi new-FPSO case remains at Pre-FEED/review with no phase change. [2026-10-13 verification] CAPEX 4.0→null: unsourced placeholder (same value as Búzios 12).

Ranking and bids: Yinson $2.29B > COOEC (+Mota-Engil+CenerTech) $2.84B > Shapoorji Pallonji (+Ocyan+Seatrium) $2.9B > MISC (+Himile) $3.05B > BW Offshore (+Saipem) $3.19B. projects.notes_en: North Field, Qatar (world's largest single non-associated gas field). 4 LNG trains × 8 Mtpa = 32 Mtpa increment. In March 2026, during the Iran-Israel conflict, existing LNG trains near Ras Laffan were struck (3/18), halting all construction; Chiyoda and other EPC staff withdrew. Chiyoda staff began returning to site in late May 2026, but Train 1 first startup is confirmed delayed from the mid-2026/Q3 target to early 2027. NFS (North Field South) is linked to 12–18 months after Train 1 startup, pushing it to H2 2028. Raises Qatar LNG capacity 77 → 126 Mtpa combined with NFS. Partners: QatarEnergy 72.5%, TotalEnergies 6.25%, Shell 6.25%, ExxonMobil 6.25%, ConocoPhillips 3.125%, Eni 3.125%, Sinopec 1.25%, CNPC 1.25%.

projects.notes_en: Masela Block, Arafura Sea, Indonesia (~800m WD). ~9.5 Mtpa LNG + 150 MMscfd pipeline gas + 35,000 bbl/d condensate. JGC awarded FEED contract August 2025. FEED 79.56% complete as of July 2026 (ahead of plan). At SKK Migas' request, FID target brought forward from 2027 to end-2026 (EPC tender to be reviewed after FEED). CAPEX ~$20.9B estimate. INPEX Masela 65% (op), Pertamina Hulu Energi 20%, PETRONAS Masela 15%. Shell sold its stake in 2023. Indonesian authorities expect first production in 2029-2030. [2026-10-13 verification] CAPEX 20.0→20.9: Indonesian government figure of US$20.9B (Antara, groundbreaking 2026-07-16). INPEX publishes no figure.

projects.notes_en: Al-Shaheen oilfield, offshore Qatar, ~100m WD. Operator: North Oil Company (QatarEnergy 70%, TotalEnergies 30%; NOC JV formed 2016, operatorship transferred 2017-07-14). Multi-batch fixed platform expansion. Batch 3 (Gallaf) first oil December 2024; Project Ru'ya (phase 3, ~100k bbl/d additional, $6B EPC, 9 WHPs + central processing facility, 200+ production wells, 550+ MMbbl recoverable) in construction/commissioning, 2027 target maintained. CAPEX ~$5B+. Sustained jack-up demand.

projects.notes: Qatar 해상, 해안 북동쪽 ~100km·Halul Island 남동쪽 28km, 수심 ~40m. 1965년부터 생산 중인 노후 유전의 수명연장·생산유지 목적 고정식 플랫폼 확장. [정정 2026-10-02] 기존 'ADNOC/아부다비'로 오기재되어 있었음 — 운영사는 QatarEnergy (MEED). EPC tender 2025-02 발행, 기술입찰 2025-09, 상업입찰 마감 2026-06-21(연장). 2026-09 EPC 낙찰자 선정: Package 1 (EPCI·HUC·브라운필드 개조 — 신규 topsides 7기 78,000t+, 메인 공정 topside 19,400t, 기존 topsides 5기 개조, bridge 4기, Halul Island 브라운필드, 파이프라인·케이블) = PTSC(베트남)+Seatrium 컨소시엄, 본계약 서명 2026-10 예정(PTSC 공시). Package 2 (topsides·umbilical·케이블 EPCI) = COOEC. 기타 입찰사: 한화오션, HD현대중공업, L&T, Saipem, McDermott(한때 Package 2 유력), Allseas. CAPEX $4–5B (MEED 추정). 공식 FID 발표 및 first oil 시점은 미공시.
projects.notes_en: Offshore Qatar, ~100km northeast of the coast and 28km southeast of Halul Island, ~40m WD. Fixed-platform expansion to extend life and sustain output of an aging field producing since 1965. [Corrected 2026-10-02] Previously mislabeled as 'ADNOC/Abu Dhabi' — operator is QatarEnergy (MEED). EPC tender issued Feb 2025, technical bids Sep 2025, commercial bid deadline 2026-06-21 (extended). EPC winners selected Sep 2026: Package 1 (EPCI, HUC, brownfield modifications — 7 new topsides 78,000t+, main process topside 19,400t, modification of 5 existing topsides, 4 bridges, Halul Island brownfield, pipelines and cables) = PTSC (Vietnam) + Seatrium consortium, main contract signing expected Oct 2026 (PTSC disclosure). Package 2 (topsides, umbilicals and cables EPCI) = COOEC. Other bidders: Hanwha Ocean, HD Hyundai Heavy Industries, L&T, Saipem, McDermott (once favored for Package 2), Allseas. CAPEX $4–5B (MEED estimate). Official FID and first oil timing undisclosed.

projects.notes_en: Blocks 31 and 31/21, offshore Angola, ultradeepwater greenfield. FID June 22, 2026. Angola's first integrated cross-block development — five fields developed via a single new FPSO. FPSO nameplate 95,000 bbl/d oil + 70 MMscfd gas. Estimated reserves 252 MMbbl (Block 31 143 MMbbl + Block 31/21 108 MMbbl). First oil H1 2029. Operated by Azule Energy (bp/Eni 50:50 JV); partners: Equinor, Sonangol E&P, ANPG.

projects.notes: Offshore Abu Dhabi, Umm Shaif field. FID July 21, 2026 ($6.2B / AED22.6B). 기존 오일 저류층 상부 가스캡(gas cap) 개발 + 응축수(condensate) 회수 극대화. EPC 계약 3건 총 $5.1B + 드릴링 프로그램 $365M(유정 14개). 생산량 600+ MMscfd 추가(UAE 국내 가스 소비량의 약 10%). ADNOC Offshore 60% (op), TotalEnergies 20%, Eni 10%, CNPC 10%. First production 목표 2030. ADNOC 47 Mtpa LNG 용량(2035) 목표 전략의 일환.
projects.notes_en: Offshore Abu Dhabi, Umm Shaif field. FID July 21, 2026 ($6.2B / AED22.6B). Development of the gas cap above the existing oil reservoir + maximized condensate recovery. Three EPC contracts totaling $5.1B + $365M drilling program (14 wells). Adds 600+ MMscfd (~10% of UAE domestic gas consumption). ADNOC Offshore 60% (op), TotalEnergies 20%, Eni 10%, CNPC 10%. First production targeted 2030. Part of ADNOC's strategy to reach 47 Mtpa LNG capacity by 2035.

projects.notes: Offshore Nigeria, OML 118 인접, 기존 Bonga FPSO(가동 2005~)로 타이백 예정. 추정 CAPEX ~$20B(indicative, 미공식). 나이지리아 정부(티누부 대통령)가 프로젝트별 세제 인센티브 제공해 2027년 FID 유도 중. 완공 시 ~150k bbl/d 원유 + 140 MMscfd 가스 생산 목표. 수심·파트너 지분 등 세부사항 미확인 — 기존 Bonga North(FID 2024-12, bp-shell-bonga-north 항목)와 별개 프로젝트. First production 시점 미정(FID 이후 산정 필요).
projects.notes_en: Offshore Nigeria, adjacent to OML 118; planned tie-back to the existing Bonga FPSO (in service since 2005). Estimated CAPEX ~$20B (indicative, unofficial). The Nigerian government (President Tinubu) is offering project-specific tax incentives to drive FID in 2027. Targets ~150k bbl/d oil + 140 MMscfd gas at completion. Water depth, partner equity and other details unconfirmed — separate from the existing Bonga North (FID Dec 2024, bp-shell-bonga-north entry). First production timing TBD (to be set after FID).
